sanitization: No credentials, private keys, raw traces, or lab config. Canary-credential sweep (incl. transformed variants, hash-only-root scoping per G5-D2b-011) ran clean on every run.
anchoring_disclosure: Same-operator demo anchoring (F22): the RFC 6962 anchor log is operated by the same party as the producer. No independent timestamping or withholding-resistance is claimed.
adapter_identity_disclosure: Adapter/mediator identity and model/firmware strings are self-asserted by the producing side; preflight cross-checks them against device readback (G5-D2b-007) but no third party attests them.

legs.adapter: adapters/vapix (TypeScript, RFC 7616 Digest direct to device)
legs.gate_supplied_inputs: Per-scenario fresh invocation/correlation IDs, evaluation time, epoch, delegation windows, expected outcome level (demo/run-scenario.ts GateInputFile); S4 pinned tamper byte + expected first-failure code supplied by the gate (G5-D2a-005).

command_effect_mapping.camera.ptz.preset: VAPIX param/ptz.cgi goto designated safe preset -> position readback polled to pan/tilt/zoom tolerance within settling deadline
command_effect_mapping.camera.stream.view: VAPIX single-JPEG endpoint via configured stream profile -> payload validated as JPEG above minimum size by the online oracle

legs.transport_observations: Independent witness proxy records request boundaries (no headers, no bodies-with-secrets); dispatch LATCHES at action-bearing send (G5-D2a-008); framing headers stripped after G5-D2b-010; S6 fault seam withholds only command-bound dispatch via x-aar-command-digest (G5-D2b-004).

scenarios.downgrade_rationale: Refusal by design: unauthorized request produced a refusal receipt and zero invocation-attributable dispatch (R-1), confirmed by instrumentation and transport witness.
Intentional pinned single-byte signature tamper; verifier fails with the expected first-failure code (F21). Physical effect occurred; the evidence is what fails.

Real producer crash-cut after send: outcome honestly encoded unknown (no independent observation of effect), resume without redispatch proven, F19 restore verified. Ran once via EP+VAPIX per Q5-2 ruling.
Backend rejected under a valid delegation; contradicted asserted only on a positively observed off-tolerance position readback, not on the rejection alone (G5-D2a-008).
Transport timed out after the action-bearing send; effect unobservable at deadline, so outcome stays unknown rather than claiming success or failure.

legs.reruns: Two independent full live runs with byte-identical scenario verdicts; gate live re-run reproduced (exit bar #8); camera rests at park.
legs.preflight_note: Preflight checks are role-scoped: the PTZ target's stream_profile check is false by design (stream runs on the stream target); top-level ok reflects the role-scoped gates that S1 requires.

legs.adapter: adapters/vms (TypeScript VmsAdapter; no device secret ever enters the TS process)
legs.mediator: adapters/vms/vigil-control (Swift/NIOHTTP1 loopback service wrapping VigilCore.AxisEngine.VAPIXClient; resolves credential REFERENCE via its own cred get; POST body = canonical command CBOR sha256-verified mediator-side)
legs.claim_boundary: VMS-mediated + second independent implementation (Swift vs TypeScript). NOT a second-protocol or cross-vendor claim: Vigil speaks VAPIX under the hood. Sentence of record: spec/GATE5-D3-REVIEW.md.
legs.gate_supplied_inputs: Same GateInputFile shape and gate-supplied fresh IDs as the VAPIX leg, driving the SAME abstract commands through the mediator.

command_effect_mapping.camera.ptz.preset: abstract op -> vigil-control /dispatch -> VigilCore VAPIXClient goto preset -> position readback to tolerance (all-zeros readback treated as sentinel, never a positive observation, per G5-D3-001)
command_effect_mapping.camera.stream.view: abstract op -> vigil-control /dispatch -> snapshot fetch -> payload validated by oracle; stream profile is echo-only through the VMS seam (G5-D3-003)

legs.transport_observations: Witness sits at the AAR->mediator boundary (proves whether the EP handed a dispatch to the VMS; ambient VMS chatter excluded per F16). Contradiction asserted only on positively contrary observation (G5-D3-002).

scenarios.downgrade_rationale: Refusal by design; zero invocation-attributable dispatch at the AAR->mediator boundary (R-1).
Intentional pinned tamper; expected first-failure code (F21).
Mediator-path fault under valid delegation; contradicted via off-tolerance position readback (position-based, not http_rejected_N — G5-D3-003).
Timeout after action-bearing send with a real device move; restore verified; outcome stays unknown.

legs.reruns: Two independent full live runs with identical verdicts; camera rests at park.

known_residuals: Adapter/mediator identity is self-asserted (preflight cross-check only; no third-party attestation).
Same-operator demo anchoring: no independent timestamping or withholding-resistance (F22).
Producer-declared completeness only: ingress completeness not_established without an independent census/reconciliation artifact (G3).
G5-D3-001 residual: a fabricated position readback with any non-zero field would still pass the sentinel check.
G5-D3-003: stream profile is echo-only through the VMS seam; profile fidelity is not independently confirmed on that leg.
S5 crash-cut exercised once, on the EP+VAPIX leg only (Q5-2 ruling).
Verifier statefulness: cross-evaluation replay/sequence properties are evaluated only when prior-state is supplied; gated runs supplied it (no stateful_not_evaluated in gated verdicts).
Operator environment: lab cameras use short (4-char) VAPIX passwords — weak beyond the lab LAN; flagged to the operator, unchanged. Cameras left digest-only (anonymous viewer/PTZ off).

verification_toolchain.reference_harness: Full Bun+TS suite (harness + adapters + demo) — 60/60 tests at v0.2-rc5 (D2b close); harness/ core suite 31/31
verification_toolchain.independent_verifier: pyref/ (Python 3.11+ stdlib clean-room) — 46/46 encoder KATs, 191/191 corpus agreement + determinism post D-57 (all 188 pre-existing verdict byte sequences proven unchanged), 0 divergences
verification_toolchain.public_cli: python -m pyref verify BUNDLE.cbor --at UNIX_SECONDS [--trust-policy POLICY.json] [--prior-state PRIOR.json]
